summary: Construct a FieldLineSet that stores fitted FieldLine lists keyed by contour level.

capability: Construct a field-line set storing fitted field-line lists keyed by contour level.
operation: contour levels and segments to an ordered field-line set
contour object and optional line keywords -> ordered level-keyed collection object
discovery.model: Direct collection construction with FieldLine keyword forwarding; no field reconstruction.
discovery.geometry: Planar contour segments and level labels; segment vertices use caller length units and levels use caller flux-label units.
discovery.boundary: Every segment must be accepted by the FieldLine constructor; topology repair and physical flux-surface qualification are excluded.

identity.direction: contour levels and segments to an ordered collection object
identity.definition: Construct FieldLine instances for every segment and store them in the flset mapping.
identity.model: Direct collection construction with FieldLine keyword forwarding.
identity.geometry: Planar contour segments and level labels.
identity.coordinates: Segment vertices in caller length units; levels in caller flux-label units.
identity.boundary: Every segment must be accepted by the FieldLine constructor.
assumptions: The contour object exposes matching levels and allsegs.
Optional kwargs are forwarded to each FieldLine.
Level and segment order are preserved.

inputs.name: contourset
inputs.units: levels in caller flux-label units; vertices length
inputs.constraints: Each allsegs entry contains finite planar segments

outputs.name: collection
outputs.description: Per-level lists of target line objects
outputs.constraints: The flset mapping is keyed by contour level and preserves segment order.

preconditions: The contour object exposes matching levels and allsegs.
Optional kwargs are forwarded to each FieldLine.
supported: Finite contour collections, keyword-forwarded sampling, and named FieldLine construction cases.
excluded: Contour topology repair, field reconstruction, and physical flux-surface qualification.

failure_semantics.invalid_input: Array or SciPy spline errors from malformed contour segments propagate.
failure_semantics.runtime_failure: Member FieldLine construction or later diagnostic exceptions propagate.
failure_semantics.nonconvergence: Not applicable; collection construction is direct.
failure_semantics.partial_results: A failed constructor returns no FieldLineSet object.

example.description: Build a FieldLineSet from one contour level and one segment.
example.code:
import numpy as np
from types import SimpleNamespace
from scirel.geometry.fieldline import FieldLineSet
c=SimpleNamespace(levels=[.2],allsegs=[[np.array([[.2,0.],[.6,0.],[1.,0.]])]])
r=FieldLineSet(c)
assert len(r.flset[.2])==1
example.expected: flset[0.2] contains one FieldLine with 1000 fitted vertices.

scope: Only the explicitly stated finite input domain and direct-test fixtures
verification.evidence_ceiling: Numerical evidence for the named fixtures only; it does not establish arbitrary-input correctness or experimental physical validation.
known_limitations: Intersection is bounded to fitted parameter intervals and rejects no-crossing/multiple-root cases; tangency/completeness remains unqualified
Arbitrary contour topology, magnetic-axis limit and physical stability are unqualified
get_kappa_n_2 requires uniform xy grid and nonzero flux gradient
